tests.title: App tests
tests.intro: Help a dev improve their app: join their testers’ group.
tests.testers: {count, plural, one {# tester} other {# testers}} of {slots}
tests.places: {count, plural, =0 {full} one {# spot left} other {# spots left}}
tests.stepsDone: {done} of {total, plural, one {# task} other {# tasks}} done
tests.noTesting: You aren’t testing any app yet.
tests.feedback: {count, plural, =0 {no feedback yet} one {# report received} other {# reports received}}
tests.toRead: {count, plural, =0 {} one {· # to read} other {· # to read}}

detail.testersOf: {count, plural, one {# tester} other {# testers}} of {slots}
detail.joinHelp: The install link is shared in the group.
detail.checkHelp: Tick each step once you’ve done it.
detail.reportSent: Report sent: {name} reads it, then validates it.
detail.reportValidated: Report validated. This test counts on your profile, thank you!
detail.reportRefused: Report refused. You can test again and send a new report.

form.title: Get tested
form.heading: Your listing
form.name: App name
form.slotsInvalid: Enter a number of testers between 1 and {max}.
form.pitchHint: Who it is for, in one or two sentences.
form.task: What you want to learn from the test
form.taskPlaceholder: For example: is ordering easy on a small phone?
form.stepsPlaceholder:
1. Sign up with a phone number
2. Add an expense
3. Share the month’s budget
form.stepsHelp: One task per line, 5 at most. Testers tick each task, then send one screenshot per task.
form.questionsHelp: A question only someone who really tested can answer. With choices, the right answer must be one of them.
form.question: Question {n}
form.error: The listing wasn’t published. Try again.
form.groupInfo: Publishing opens your testers’ group in your messages, with the install link. Each tester joins it by joining the test.

report.title: Your report
report.badFile: “{name}” isn’t accepted: use a PNG, JPEG or WebP image of 2 MB or less.
report.needShots: {count, plural, one {Add # screenshot, one per step of the scenario.} other {Add # screenshots, one per step of the scenario.}}
report.needDevice: Tell us which device you used.
report.error: The report wasn’t sent. Try again.
report.sentBody: {name} will read it, then validate it. You’ll get a notification.
report.remarksPlaceholder: What got you stuck, what was clear…
report.help: {name} validates your report after reading it.

review.title: Reports received
review.subtitle: {name} · {count, plural, one {# report} other {# reports}}, {toRead} to read
review.refuseLabel: Why are you refusing this report?
review.refuseHint: {name} will see your answer and can take the test again.
review.error: Your answer wasn’t saved. Try again.
review.empty: No reports yet. Testers from the community are on their way.

tests.emptyText: Be the first: publish your app and a group of testers forms around it.
